narrative.overview: Every surface of TechPulse reads like a terminal session left running at midnight: a deep-violet phosphor canvas, hairline-ruled panes, and a single lavender signal color that behaves like a live cursor — present, precise, and never decorative. A light green heartbeat threads through the live indicators — the pulse dot, SYS.ONLINE, the blinking cursor block — so the page feels alive and soulful, not static chrome. The system is a technical spec-sheet dressed as a club site: field numbers, mono uppercase labels, dotted indicators, and ruled borders that separate information the way code comments separate sections.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-violet phosphor canvas (#120d1c) with hairline-ruled panels (#2c2345 / #26203f).
One lavender signal (#b497cf) for structural accent, lit by a light green heartbeat (#a8e08f) on live indicators.
Sharp corners everywhere — radius is zero by doctrine.
JetBrains Mono for every label, kicker, stat, and index; Space Grotesk for reading and display; Instrument Serif italic for rare editorial voice.
Flat by default; shadow is a hover-state response, not an ambient condition.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Lavender structures, green breathes. Lavender marks the selected/structural signal; green marks only what is currently alive and pulsing. Both together cover ≤10% of any given screen — their rarity is the point.

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are flat fills; the only permitted gradients are the backdrop scrim and the ambient radial glows (lavender pillar, green under-glow), never decorative color ramps.

rules.name: The Ink Ground Rule
rules.body: Every color sits on ink or surface — lavender, green, mist, and muted are never used as page backgrounds, only as foreground signal, fills, and borders.

rules.name: The Mono Label Rule
rules.body: Any text that names, numbers, or categorizes is JetBrains Mono uppercase with wide tracking. If it reads like a label, it is set in mono. If it reads like a sentence, it is set in Space Grotesk.

rules.name: The Serif Rarity Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif appears at most twice per page. It is the editorial exception, not a body voice.

rules.name: The Tight-Tracking Rule
rules.body: All sans display and headline text tracks tight (-0.02em to -0.03em) and sets leading to 1 or below. Air is added with margin, never with line-height.

rules.name: The Ruled-Document Rule
rules.body: Every major section is separated by a full-width hairline and shares the same 72rem measure. Vertical rhythm comes from rules and consistent padding, not from scattered backgrounds.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, active, emphasis) — never as ambient page furniture.

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: Nothing is rounded except signal dots. Radius is 0 by default; adding any corner rounding breaks the terminal metaphor.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px borders, never with background contrast alone.

dos: Do set every label, kicker, index, stat, and button in JetBrains Mono uppercase with wide tracking — it is the signature voice.
Do use lavender for structural/selected signals and green only for live pulsing indicators — pulse dots, SYS.ONLINE, blinking cursor block, marquee diamonds, scroll cue.
Do keep every corner at radius 0.
Do use 1px hairlines (#2c2345 / #26203f) to structure space.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; introduce shadow only on hover or for stated emphasis.
Do use Instrument Serif italic sparingly — the tagline and one quote per page.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion (reduced: no animation, no reveal transforms).
donts: Don't introduce a third accent hue — lavender structures, green breathes, and that is the whole signal strategy.
Don't round corners on buttons, cards, panels, or inputs.
Don't use lavender or green as a background fill beyond button/chip/pill forms.
Don't add ambient drop shadows to resting cards.
Don't use gradients for decoration — only the backdrop scrim and ambient radial glows are permitted.
Don't set body copy wider than max-w-xl (36rem).
Don't render the serif voice in more than two places on a page.
